AISearchResourceAdd.title: AISearchResourceAdd
AISearchResourceAdd.summary: Adds a structured element to an AISearch project. Supported element types include miniapp and product.

AISearchResourceDelete.title: AISearchResourceDelete
AISearchResourceDelete.summary: Delete a structured element from an AISearch project by specifying the resource type and resource ID.

AISearchResourceGetList.title: AISearchResourceGetList
AISearchResourceGetList.summary: When you query structured resources in AISearch, you must specify a resource type. The supported types are Mini Program (miniapp) and product. If you provide a resource ID, the query returns the specified resource. If you do not provide a resource ID, the query returns all resources of that type by paging.

AISearchResourceUpdate.title: AISearchResourceUpdate
AISearchResourceUpdate.summary: Updates structured elements in an AISearch project. Supported element types include miniapps (miniapp) and products (product).

AISearchStream.title: AISearchStream
AISearchStream.summary: The AISearch Q&A interface answers customer questions using structured element information from the database and content retrieved from the knowledge base.

AddFolder.title: AddFolder
AddFolder.summary: Adds a folder and returns an entity that contains basic information about the folder.

AnalyzeVlRealtime.title: AnalyzeVlRealtime
AnalyzeVlRealtime.summary: Extracts information from a VL in real time.

BatchSaveInstructionStatus.title: BatchSaveInstructionStatus
BatchSaveInstructionStatus.summary: Provides feedback on the execution status of policies.

BatchUpdateSystemRunningPlan.title: BatchUpdateSystemRunningPlan
BatchUpdateSystemRunningPlan.summary: Updates the running plans for multiple air conditioner sites in a batch.

Chat.title: Document Q\&A
Chat.summary: This API provides a knowledge base service that answers questions about documents in a selected folder, using the session's chat history as context.

ChatStream.title: Streaming Document Q\&A
ChatStream.summary: This operation performs streaming Q&A on selected documents in a knowledge base, using the conversation history from a specified session as context.

CreateChatSession.title: Create Q\&A Session
CreateChatSession.summary: Creates a chat session for knowledge base question answering. Each session maintains its own Q&A history as context to provide more accurate answers.

DeleteDocument.title: DeleteDocument
DeleteDocument.summary: Deletes a parsed file by task ID. Returns true on success, or false on failure.

DeleteFolder.title: DeleteFolder
DeleteFolder.summary: Deletes a folder. If the operation is successful, a Boolean value of `true` is returned. If the folder does not exist, a 4xx error is returned with the message "The folder does not exist."

DetailDocument.title: DetailDocument
DetailDocument.summary: Retrieves the details of a document by its task ID.

EditProhibitedDevices.title: EditProhibitedDevices
EditProhibitedDevices.summary: Edits the list of prohibited devices.

GenerateResult.title: GenerateResult
GenerateResult.summary: Generates a report for a specified carbon footprint.

GetAreaElecConstitute.title: GetAreaElecConstitute
GetAreaElecConstitute.summary: Retrieves analytical data for power stations.

GetChatFolderList.title: Get Q\&A folder List
GetChatFolderList.summary: Retrieves the list of Q&A pair folders.

GetChatList.title: Get Q\\\&A List
GetChatList.summary: Retrieves the Q&A pair history for a session.

GetChatSessionList.title: Get Document Session List
GetChatSessionList.summary: Retrieves a list of a user's Q&A sessions.

GetDataItemList.title: GetDataItemList
GetDataItemList.summary: Retrieves a list of data item details.

GetDataQualityAnalysis.title: GetDataQualityAnalysis
GetDataQualityAnalysis.summary: Retrieves the Data Quality Rating (DQR) and Data Quality Indicator (DQI) results.

GetDeviceInfo.title: GetDeviceInfo
GetDeviceInfo.summary: Retrieves device information for an activated site.

GetDeviceList.title: GetDeviceList
GetDeviceList.summary: Retrieves the list of devices for an activated site.

GetDocExtractionResult.title: Retrieve RAG and Long Text Understanding Document Extraction Results
GetDocExtractionResult.summary: For Querying Information Extraction Result. The input parameter taskId is obtained from the taskId returned by the interfaces SubmitDocExtractionTaskAdvance or SubmitDocExtractionTask. The query results can reflect one of three statuses: processing, successfully completed, or failed.

GetDocParsingResult.title: Get Document Parsing Result
GetDocParsingResult.summary: For Querying Document Parsing Results. The input parameter taskId is obtained from the taskId returned by the interfaces SubmitDocParsingTaskAdvance or SubmitDocParsingTask. The query results can be one of three statuses: processing, successful, or failed.

GetDocumentAnalyzeResult.title: GetDocumentAnalyzeResult
GetDocumentAnalyzeResult.summary: Important: This API operation is no longer maintained. To obtain extraction results, use the getDocExtractionResult or GetVLExtractionResult operation.

GetEmissionSourceConstitute.title: GetEmissionSourceConstitute
GetEmissionSourceConstitute.summary: Retrieves the composition of emission sources.

GetEpdInventoryConstitute.title: GetEpdInventoryConstitute
GetEpdInventoryConstitute.summary: Retrieves the detailed results of environmental impact categories.

GetEpdSummary.title: GetEpdSummary
GetEpdSummary.summary: Retrieves the total emissions for various environmental impact categories.

GetFootprintList.title: GetFootprintList
GetFootprintList.summary: Retrieves a list of product carbon footprints.

GetGwpBenchmarkList.title: GetGwpBenchmarkList
GetGwpBenchmarkList.summary: Retrieves a ranked list of active carbon reduction initiatives.

GetGwpBenchmarkSummary.title: GetGwpBenchmarkSummary
GetGwpBenchmarkSummary.summary: Retrieves the total proactive carbon reduction.

GetGwpInventoryConstitute.title: GetGwpInventoryConstitute
GetGwpInventoryConstitute.summary: Retrieves the carbon emission composition analysis for a specified product. The analysis provides a breakdown across two dimensions: by checklist and by type. The results are rendered as a hierarchical list and a pie chart.

GetGwpInventorySummary.title: GetGwpInventorySummary
GetGwpInventorySummary.summary: Retrieves the total carbon footprint of a product and provides details about its top four contributors.

GetInventoryList.title: GetInventoryList
GetInventoryList.summary: Retrieves a descending list of emissions for a specified environmental impact (methodType), grouping level (group), and calculation method (emissionType).

GetOrgAndFactory.title: GetOrgAndFactory
GetOrgAndFactory.summary: Queries the organizations and sites that are activated for an account. Sites that are not activated in the console are excluded from the response.

GetOrgConstitute.title: GetOrgConstitute
GetOrgConstitute.summary: Retrieves analytical data for a carbon inventory organization.

GetPcrInfo.title: GetPcrInfo
GetPcrInfo.summary: Retrieves the OSS URL of a product carbon footprint PCR report.

GetVLExtractionResult.title: Get VL Extraction Result
GetVLExtractionResult.summary: For Querying Qwen-VL Model Information Extraction Results. The input parameter taskId is obtained from the taskId returned by the interfaces SubmitVLExtractionTask or SubmitVLExtractionTaskAdvance. The query results can be in one of three statuses: processing, successfully completed, or failed.

IsCompleted.title: IsCompleted
IsCompleted.summary: Checks the completion status of a report generation task.

PushDeviceData.title: PushDeviceData
PushDeviceData.summary: Pushes data from device data points, such as voltage data from an electric meter.

PushItemData.title: PushItemData
PushItemData.summary: This interface is used to push data items.

Retrieve.title: Retrieve
Retrieve.summary: This API retrieves results for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) from one or more folder or file IDs. You can then process these results and embed them in your business logic.

SubmitDocExtractionTask.title: Asynchronously Submit RAG and Long Text Understanding Information Extraction Tasks
SubmitDocExtractionTask.summary: Extracts key information from a document based on a preset key-value template or prompt template. A successful call returns a task ID. You can then call GetDocExtractionResult to retrieve the extraction results. Asynchronously submits a task for a file specified by a URL. To submit a task for a local file, use the SubmitDocExtractionTaskAdvance operation.

SubmitDocParsingTask.title: Asynchronously Submit Document Parsing Task
SubmitDocParsingTask.summary: Parses content, such as text, tables, and images, from a document. A successful call returns a task ID. You can then call `GetDocParsingResult` to retrieve the parsing results. The `SubmitDocParsingTask` operation asynchronously submits a task for a file URL. The `SubmitDocParsingTaskAdvance` operation asynchronously submits a task for a local file.

SubmitDocumentAnalyzeJob.title: SubmitDocumentAnalyzeJob
SubmitDocumentAnalyzeJob.summary: The document parsing operation is used to extract the key content of a document and extract the key-value information from the document based on the preset key-value template. The document parsing operation is an asynchronous operation. You need to call the asynchronous submission service for document parsing and then call the GetDocumentAnalyzeResult operation to perform result polling. The asynchronous submission service supports two methods: local files and URL files. Call the SubmitDocumentAnalyzeJob operation to upload URL files. Call the SubmitDocumentAnalyzeJobAdvance operation to upload local files.

SubmitVLExtractionTask.title: Asynchronously Submit VL Information Extraction Task
SubmitVLExtractionTask.summary: Extracts key information from documents using KV templates or prompts with the Qwen-VL model, ideal for image extraction. Supports: URL Upload: SubmitVLExtractionTask. Local File Upload: SubmitVLExtractionTaskAdvance
